messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ShinyUI
parts:
Currently either you use those 3, or you throw it all away and use bootstrapPage instead of pageWithSidebar. bootstrapPage gives you an empty body where you can use any of Bootstrap's classes (see Bootstrap's examples here), like so:

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  div(class="container",
    div(class="row",
      div(class="span4",
        div(class="well", ...)
      ),
      div(class="span8", ...)
    )
  )
))
